subject: Escalation: Candidate Elena Torres - Leveling dispute & offer coordination
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate Elena Torres - leveling dispute & urgent offer coordination

Neha,

I'm escalating a leveling/feedback dispute for Elena Torres (candidate in SRE lane). We completed interviews last week and the panel is split: two interviewers recommended Senior SRE II (L4) while one senior IC pushed for Senior SRE III (L5) citing broad system design + on-call leadership. I reviewed the notes (attached) and I believe her impact and autonomy are closer to L4 with a fast ramp to L5 based on the role's scope. Compensation band for L5 would be ~25% higher than what we can realistically offer within our current hiring budget.

Candidate is actively considering another offer and Sarah from Acme Recruiting flagged that Elena expects an answer by EOD Thursday (2026-03-05). I want HR to:
- Confirm leveling rubric interpretation and whether calibration should be the tie-breaker here.
- Recommend offer approach to land candidate within our band (possible higher midpoint vs bumping to L5).
- If level change is required, escalate for VP sign-off and a brief rationale for removing the inconsistency in panel feedback.

Attached: resume, consolidated interview notes, our leveling grid for quick reference. Happy to hop on a 20-min alignment call. This is time-sensitive — candidate lead time is tight.

Thanks,
Monica
Hiring Manager, Platform SRE
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Elena_Torres_Resume.pdf (pdf), Elena_interview_notes.docx (docx), leveling_grid_q1_2026.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate Elena Torres - leveling dispute & urgent offer coordination

Thanks for the context, Monica — I reviewed the attachments. We'll treat this as an expedited calibration. A few quick notes:

- Our leveling rubric emphasizes scope of ownership and demonstrated leadership beyond IC contribution. The interview notes show strong system design and some cross-team influence but limited examples of org-level impact.
- Panel variance is common; we usually default to the majority recommendation unless a strong documented rationale exists for bumping.
- We can explore a "level-with-higher-midpoint" approach: extend at L4 but at the top quartile midpoint, plus a performance review at 6 months tied to a potential level re-eval.

Can you confirm the budget flexibility around base compensation and equity? If not, I'll draft two offer templates (L4/top-quartile and L5/standard) and flag what approvals are needed. I can also pull in People Ops for final sign-off if you want a formal exception.

I can join a call later today at 4pm PT if that works.

—Neha
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate Elena Torres - leveling dispute & urgent offer coordination

Looping in my perspective quickly — Monica's read aligns with mine. Elena demonstrated strong ownership and the ability to shape incident response processes, which we need on Platform. My preference is to avoid losing her over a strict leveling disagreement. If HR thinks a L4/top-quartile with a clear 6-month re-eval is acceptable, I support that. If we must make an exception for L5, I'll advocate for it to the VP, but we should be mindful of internal equity.

Monica/Vivek (signature)
VP, Platform Engineering

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate Elena Torres - leveling dispute & urgent offer coordination

Folks, after running Elena's case through the rubric calibration and consulting with People Ops (Maya CC'd), here's the HR recommendation:

Option A (recommended): Extend offer at Senior SRE II (L4) at the top quartile base for L4 plus a signing bonus of $8,000 and an auto re-evaluation at 6 months tied to documented impact milestones. This keeps internal equity intact while materially improving the package to be competitive.

Option B (exception): Move to Senior SRE III (L5) but requires VP People Ops sign-off and justification for long-term alignment with comp bands; note this creates a comp precedent we should document (People Ops would open an exception case HR-872).

Numbers (approx):
- L4 top quartile base: $165,000
- Signing bonus: $8,000 one-time
- L5 midpoint (for reference): $205,000
- Proposed equity at L4/top quartile: 0.09%

If we go Option A, I can prepare an offer packet and the DocuSign template; we'd need final approval to increase the base to the top quartile and to include the 6-month level re-eval clause. If you want Option B, Maya will need to sign the exception and we'll formalize HR-872 and route to Exec Compensation.

Please confirm which path you want HR to execute; candidate timeline still looks like EOD Thu.

—Neha
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate Elena Torres - leveling dispute & urgent offer coordination

Thanks, Neha — I agree with Option A. My team is keen to move quickly and a top-quartile L4 offer with the $8k signing bonus and a 6-month re-eval is acceptable. Please prepare the offer packet and route through DocuSign; include the performance milestones we discussed (lead incident runbook, own two cross-team projects, reduce mean time-to-detect by measurable metric).

Maya — please confirm you are okay with the L4/top-quartile approach and that we do not need a formal L5 exception. If you approve, Neha please proceed and loop in Sarah at Acme Recruiting so she can manage candidate expectations.

I'll be out of pocket from 3/10 morning but available for any quick approvals by slack if needed.

Thanks,
Monica
Hiring Manager, Platform SRE
Redwood Inference
